title: Fried Feta Saganski
ingredients: 1 block of feta cheese about 100-150 grams / 3,5-5oz
method: Beat the egg in a wide bowl .
Dip feta in the egg and then coat with flour.
Cook in frying oil for aproximately 8 minutes for a golden brown color.
Transfer to paper towel to drain.
Serve by squeezing a few drops of fresh lemon on top.
